description: This file manages scheduling, executing, and deleting AI phone call reminders within a workflow system, including extracting phone numbers, scheduling calls based on event timing, and interfacing with task scheduling and database modules.

methods.name: extractPhoneNumber
methods.description: Extracts the phone number from responses, prioritizing specific fields.

methods.name: createWorkflowReminderAndExtractPhone
methods.description: Creates a workflow reminder and extracts the attendee's phone number.

methods.name: scheduleAIPhoneCall
methods.description: Schedules an AI phone call based on event timing and configuration.

methods.name: scheduleAIPhoneCallForEvt
methods.description: Handles scheduling or immediate execution of AI phone calls for event-based triggers.

methods.name: scheduleAIPhoneCallForForm
methods.description: Handles immediate AI phone call scheduling for form submissions.

methods.name: scheduleAIPhoneCallTask
methods.description: Creates a task to execute the AI phone call.

methods.name: deleteScheduledAIPhoneCall
methods.description: Cancels and deletes a scheduled AI phone call reminder.
